MEET THE ARTIST / 단편선 순간들

Danpyunsun and the Moments Ensemble

Danpyunsun and the Moments Ensemble brings songwriter and producer Danpyunsun together with players on piano, bass, drums and guitar. The album notes for Hail to the Music describe wanting to capture the time in which people watch, feel and respond to one another.

BY INDIEK / PUBLISHED 2026-11-12

Listen ↓Inside the lyrics ↓
SONG PAGESYou, Me and Namyangju ↗Hail to the Music ↗

The ensemble announced its beginning in January 2024. Its lineup that year included pianist Lee Boram, bassist Song Hyunwoo, drummer Park Jaejun and guitarist Park Jangmi alongside Danpyunsun.

INDIE ROCK / 2025

You, Me and Namyangju당신과 나 남양주에서

Official audio

View release on Apple Music ↗

“You, Me and Namyangju” places an uncertain encounter in the snow beside a fox’s account of its present life. The speaker watches someone move away, while the ending leaves room for both contentment and thoughts of someone absent.

Lyrics by Danpyunsun; music by Danpyunsun; arranged by Danpyunsun, Lee Boram (이보람), Song Hyunwoo (송현우), Park Jaejun (박재준) and Park Jangmi (박장미); produced by Danpyunsun.

Official audio · 03:27

INDIE ROCK / 2024

Hail to the Music음악만세

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

The album notes for Hail to the Music close with a wish to ask people enduring the world together to come along. This song shares the album’s title.

A little background

The song was released on September 10, 2024, on the album of the same name. The linked video is a live performance by the ensemble, separate from the studio recording.

Lyrics by Danpyunsun; music by Danpyunsun; arranged by Danpyunsun, Lee Boram (이보람), Song Hyunwoo (송현우), Park Jaejun (박재준) and Park Jangmi (박장미); produced by Danpyunsun.
